newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil prison rebellion ends with four dead.
newsitem.headline: Brazil prison rebellion ends with four dead.

text.p: A prison rebellion at a jail in Sao Paulo state in which four inmates were killed and at least 15 injured ended on Monday after 48 hours, a prison official said.

A group of prisoners at the jail in Praia Grande, a coastal city 50 miles (80 kms) south of Sao Paulo, tried unsuccessfully to escape on Saturday, sparking a rebellion involving all 500 detainees at the jail.
The official said the inmates had released the prison guard they were holding hostage and 15 prisoners had been transferred to another jail. The inmates, armed with knives, had demanded the transfer.

The rebellion followed a thwarted jailbreak attempt a few days earlier in Sao Paulo in which four prisoners and a guard were killed when five detainees tried to escape from Latin America's largest prison, Carandiru, using a garbage truck.
